TASK_RECONCILIATION.task: Repository archaeology found legacy `HectonSurvivalSystem`, physiology/player surfaces, and overlapping timer debt.
Integrated through existing `ShinobuMetabolismRuntime` partial ownership instead of adding a competing manager.
Starvation, dehydration, hypothermia, and toxicity damage are staged as unmanaged `CombatDamageSignal` rows and published after owner job finalization.
Legacy composite `HectonSurvivalSystem` timers are documented but not deleted because that owner still carries unrelated O2, pressure, radiation, save, UI, and environment authority.
Temperature truth samples retained voxel thermal readback instead of biome strings.
`GenerateMockThermalEnvironmentJob` writes deterministic y-major/x-z thermal gradients matching production grid layout.
Burst metabolism integration applies Newton cooling with deterministic rational decay, retained thermal pointer fence, and `[NoAlias]` pointers.
Calories drain from basal rule data plus velocity-squared exertion staging.
Freezing presentation is shader frost scalar plus editor cube bars, not CPU post-process or mesh frost.
Fatigue is a metabolism flag/scalar consumed by KCC through a guarded Vault read; SHINOBU does not mutate movement authority.
SlowTick cadence maps continuously from 1.0s to 0.1s through `GlobalQualityWeight` while preserving accumulated dt.
Thermal/chemical grid sampling subtracts grid root AUP from entity AUP in double precision before local float indexing.
All metabolism jobs use deterministic Burst compile attributes and avoid `math.exp` for rollback-sensitive cooling.
Owned Vault buffers use uninitialized memory where deterministic jobs/default rows overwrite active lanes.
Aggregate and detail 300-frame telemetry rings plus `Dump_SHINOBU_320.bin` fault path are wired.
Editor tuning writes Vault rows through explicit locks and `UnsafeUtility.AsRef`.
Suit thermal CSV parser is cold editor/development only, span-based, and production-gated pending Data Monolith.
Editor debug gizmo is isolated in a `UNITY_EDITOR` partial and draws zero-label color bars from cached Vault snapshots.
`OOP_Survival_Scanner` uses Roslyn AST with token fallback and non-destructive report upsert.
Static checks pass. Legal rebuild now fails only on external `BaseAirlock` namespace debt.
